item.minecraft.armor_stand.description: Use %s + %s with an empty hand to open configuration screen.
screen.statuemenus.poses.credits: Some content on this page originates from the Vanilla Tweaks "Armor Statues" data pack. Click this button to go to their website!
screen.statuemenus.style.tooltip: Set a name to display above the statue.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.sho: Shows the statue's arms, so it may hold items in either hand.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.sma: Makes the statue half it's size like a baby mob.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.inv: Makes the statue itself invisible, but still shows all equipped items.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.no_: Hide the stone base plate at the statue's feet.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.sho: Render the statue's name tag above it's head.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.imm: Makes the statue have no physics in the world, so it may float freely.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.inv: The statue can neither be broken nor killed in survival mode.
screen.statuemenus.style.statuemenus.sea: Disallows changing equipment and opening this menu in survival mode.
screen.statuemenus.position.centered.des: Align an armor stand in the center of the block position it is placed on.
screen.statuemenus.position.cornered.des: Align an armor stand at the corner of the block position it is placed on.
screen.statuemenus.rotations.tip1: Hold any §dShift§r or §dAlt§r key to lock two-dimensional sliders to a single axis while dragging!
screen.statuemenus.rotations.tip2: Use arrow keys to move sliders with greater precision than when dragging! Focus a slider first by clicking.
screen.statuemenus.alignments.statuemenu: Align an armor stand placed on a surface so that a block held by it appears on the surface.
Align an armor stand placed on a surface so that an item held by it appears upright on the surface.
Align an armor stand placed on a surface so that a non-tool item held by it appears flat on the surface.
Align an armor stand placed on a surface so that a tool held by it appears flat on the surface.
data_sync.armorstatues.failure: Unable to modify armor stand data: %s
data_sync.armorstatues.finished: Finished sending queued armor stand data
screen.armorstatues.vanilla_tweaks.check: Highlights the closest armor stand within three blocks of the player which will be adjusted. Due to how data packs work, this isn't necessarily the armor stand which opened this menu.
Locking an armor stand prevents it from being changed using this menu and disables interaction with the equipment slots.
screen.armorstatues.vanilla_tweaks.unloc: Unlocking an armor stand reverts any adjustments made via a previous lock action.
screen.armorstatues.vanilla_tweaks.tool_: Align an armor stand with a tripwire hook on the wall above it so that a tool held by it appears to be hanging up. Also locks the armor stand and disables all slots except the mainhand.
screen.armorstatues.vanilla_tweaks.swap_: Swaps items between the main hand and off hand equipment slots.
Swaps items between the main hand and helmet equipment slots.
setting.armorstatues.use_vanilla_tweaks_: Use Vanilla Tweaks Armor Statues data pack /trigger commands when editing armor stands on a server without this mod.
setting.armorstatues.client_command_dela: Delay in ticks between queued Vanilla Tweaks trigger commands sent to a server without this mod.
